title: Maratha Empire (1674-1818)
key_facts: Hindu warrior confederacy that challenged Mughal rule
Controlled large parts of Indian subcontinent for 150 years
Known for military innovation and guerrilla warfare tactics
Established Pune as capital center of power and culture
causes: Mughal Empire's decline after Aurangzeb's death
Shivaji's establishment of independent Hindu kingdom
Maratha military organization and light cavalry tactics
Support from various Indian kingdoms opposing Mughal authority
outcome: Eventually defeated by British East India Company
Third Anglo-Maratha War ended formal Maratha power
Left legacy of Hindu resistance and regional identity
Contributed to Indian independence movement centuries later
impacts: Established Hindu military traditions in Indian warfare
Created regional power centers that influenced Indian politics
Contributed to rise of Indian nationalism against British rule
